injuries_home.name: Nate Bittle
injuries_home.note: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries_home.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
injuries_home.note: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries_home.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries_home.note: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries_home.name: Jonathan Kuminga
injuries_home.note: Kuminga (shoulder) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 106-98 win over Portland and did not return. He closed with 13 points (5-12 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), nine rebounds and one assist across 29 minutes.

injuries_home.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries_home.note: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries_home.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries_home.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries_home.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries_home.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries_away.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries_away.note: Youngblood (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.

injuries_away.name: Vít Krejčí
injuries_away.note: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries_away.name: Ja Morant
injuries_away.note: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

injuries_away.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries_away.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries_home.name: Tobias Harris
injuries_home.note: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries_home.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries_home.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries_away.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries_away.note: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

injuries_away.name: Taurean Prince
injuries_away.note: Prince (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries_away.name: Ronald Holland II
injuries_away.note: Holland is out for Tuesday's game against San Antonio due to a left knee contusion.

injuries_away.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries_away.note: Joe (hip) is doubtful to play in Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries_away.name: Jalen Duren
injuries_away.note: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries_home.name: Yanic Konan Niederhäuser
injuries_home.note: Niederhauser (foot) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Jazz.

injuries_home.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries_home.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries_home.name: Bradley Beal
injuries_home.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries_home.name: Jordan Miller
injuries_home.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries_away.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries_away.note: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries_away.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries_away.note: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries_away.name: Jusuf Nurkić
injuries_away.note: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries_away.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries_away.note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries_home.name: Austin Reaves
injuries_home.note: Reaves (heel) is out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

injuries_home.name: Walker Kessler
injuries_home.note: Walker (leg) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets.

injuries_away.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries_away.note: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries_away.name: Dennis Schröder
injuries_away.note: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
